item.title: EasySqueezy 1.0.3
item.description:
### EasySqueezy 1.0.3
- Help › Send Feedback… now fills in what helps us look into a problem: your EasySqueezy and macOS versions, your settings, and the last few squeezes (never file names). - The estimated file size lines up neatly under the choices above it. - A darker wordmark, matching the rest of the family. - The About window always opens in front.
